name: browser-use
headline: UX Skill for Claude: Web Audits & Design Specs
short_description: Professional UX tooling for Claude that automates audits, accessibility checks, design specs, and usability testing with structured workflows and templates.
author: altock

sections.overview:
The UX Skill for Claude is a knowledge-based tooling plugin that equips Claude with structured workflows, reference materials, and templates for professional UX work. It enables UX audits using Nielsen's heuristics, accessibility reviews against WCAG 2.2 AA standards, design specification generation with acceptance criteria, and usability test planning. The skill includes pre-built checklists for forms, accessibility, navigation, and responsive design, plus output templates for audit reports and implementation specs. Designers, product managers, and developers use it to systematize UX validation, catch usability issues early, and document design requirements within their Claude-powered workflows.
Conduct structured UX audits on web applications using Nielsen heuristics
Generate accessibility compliance reports against WCAG 2.2 AA standards
Create design specifications with acceptance criteria for developers
Plan and document usability testing protocols
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/altock/ux-webapp`
sections.usage:
```
Conduct a UX audit for a [COMPANY] web app in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Focus on accessibility, usability, and design consistency. Provide actionable recommendations based on [DATA] from user testing and analytics.
```
